section: 19-20 - SYMBOL/TIMEFRAME/PROVIDER STATE SAFETY AND LIVE/HISTORICAL/REPLAY ISOLATION
finding: The cross-contamination guard (frontend/src/store/terminal-store.ts setSymbol/setTimeframe/acceptDecision + frontend/src/lib/overlays.ts::decisionMatchesWorkspace) is already fully generic and was already proven with an analogous Derived-family sequence (Phase 2 checkpoint 10: rapid R_75 M5 -> other symbol -> R_75 M15 -> R_75 M5) and a Forex-vs-Derived switch (existing test: 'cannot apply a Forex response after switching back to Derived', using EUR/USD). No production code changed for these checkpoints -- only new tests using the exact GBP/USD <-> R_75 combination the Phase 4 spec names.

checkpoint_19_state_safety.test: frontend/src/store/terminal-store.test.ts :: 'leaves no stale state and rejects late responses across GBP/USD M5 -> GBP/USD M15 -> R_75 M5 -> GBP/USD M5 (Phase 4 checkpoint 19)'
verified: GBP/USD M5 -> GBP/USD M15: M5 decision cleared, late M5-tagged response rejected on the M15 view
GBP/USD M15 -> R_75 M5 (provider switch twelve_data -> deriv): no Forex decision/owner/session leaks into the Deriv workspace; marketSource/marketSchedule correctly become deriv/24_7
R_75 M5 -> GBP/USD M5 (provider switch deriv -> twelve_data): R_75 decision/owner cleared; a late Deriv response tagged for R_75 is rejected once back on Forex
a correctly-tagged fresh GBP/USD M5 response is still accepted normally, with its session field intact
checkpoint_19_state_safety.stale_response_rejection_both_providers: PASS -- both a late Twelve Data (GBP/USD) response and a late Deriv (R_75) response are rejected by requestId + decisionMatchesWorkspace at each hop
checkpoint_19_state_safety.backend_tagging_consistency: PASS -- tests/test_phase4_state_safety_isolation.py confirms GBP/USD decisions always carry symbol_id namespaced twelve_data:, market_type=forex, decision_owner_id=ict_2022, and meta.symbol/timeframe matching the request -- exactly what decisionMatchesWorkspace keys off of

checkpoint_20_live_historical_replay_iso.mechanism: workspaceMode (live/historical/replay) + overlay_mode (LIVE/REPLAY/HISTORICAL) double-gating in terminal-store.ts::showReplay/showHistorical/returnLive/acceptDecision -- unchanged, generic, already covered by 3 pre-existing Phase 2/3 tests ('never presents a live refresh as part of historical inspection', 'isolates replay drawings and clears them when returning live', 'refuses an inspection decision tagged for a different overlay mode')
checkpoint_20_live_historical_replay_iso.gbpusd_specific_verification: PASS -- tests/test_phase4_state_safety_isolation.py confirms the same GBP/USD candle bundle produces overlay_mode=LIVE/meta.live=True when evaluated live, and overlay_mode=REPLAY/meta.live=False when evaluated in replay, via the identical normalize_market_decision(..., live=...) call app.py makes for both modes
checkpoint_20_live_historical_replay_iso.no_forex_specific_isolation_gap_found: The isolation boundary operates on overlay_mode/workspaceMode alone, never on market_type -- so it structurally cannot special-case (or fail to protect) Forex differently from any other market family
